label: Fires only at D1, mostly when the trial two back reached S1 unrewarded.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * (tv('state', -2) == S1) * (tv('reward', -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is('a1 S1 u') ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1)
terms: (phase == D1) * (tv("state", -2) == S1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == S1) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("state", -2) == -9) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("state", -3) == S1) * (tv("reward", -3) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * np.abs(belief_lo) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("state", -2) == S2) * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (tv("state", -2) == S1) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (prev_reward == 0)
explanation: Hidden/16 is nonzero only at D1. Its magnitude is driven mainly by a lagged outcome: the trial two back reached S1 and was unrewarded (weight about +0.85). A smaller boost comes when the last trial was a1 -> S1 unrewarded (+0.4). A rewarded trial two back lowers it, so windows with unknown early history sit higher. Two back S1 unrewarded followed by another omission adds a little more. Things that matter little or not at all: the last trial in general (residual table 0.11 vs 0.45 for the trial before), belief_lo (small effect), the hidden good state, and future variables. The free fit adds a three-back S1 omission, a missing-history indicator and belief certainty, and reaches dev 0.50 vs 0.48 for the short form. Unexplained: large activations on the first window trials, whose relevant history lies outside the window.

issues: The main claim holds. On test, the single term (D1) * two-back S1 unrewarded scores R^2 0.390 beyond timing on its own. Splitting it by rewarded S1 (weight +0.02) or by rare transition (+0.13, R^2 0.451) adds little, so the driver really is an S1 omission two trials back.

The +0.42 last-trial boost is specific to a1 -> S1 unrewarded. Swapping it for the generic prev_state==S1 & prev_reward==0 drops test R^2 to 0.446 (and to 0.408 with a three-back term). The label leaves this term out entirely.

The third term's story is off. 'Rewarded trial two back lowers it, so windows with unknown early history sit higher' does not hold up. A missing-history indicator (tv('state',-2)==-9) scores only 0.438. Using LAST trial rewarded (prev_reward==1) instead scores better: test 0.486 vs 0.478, weight -0.13.

Misses on the recorded form leave systematic over-prediction at D1 after a1 S2 r (-0.19) and under-prediction after a2 S2 u (+0.12). With prev_reward==1 as the third term these shrink to D1 after a1 S2 r/u about -0.16 and D1 after unknown history +0.08. These are modest, and adding rare-transition terms did not help (0.454).
The label covers only the first term. It omits the a1->S1-unrewarded boost and the reward-related reduction, so a reader cannot fully predict the lows.
